title: BTGO DEADLINE: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages BitGo Holdings, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BTGO
author: Rosen Law Firm
description: Rosen Law Firm is notifying investors in BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) and GRAIL, Inc. (NASDAQ: GRAL) of ongoing securities class action lawsuits. BitGo investors who purchased shares during the IPO on January 22, 2026 or between January 22 and May 13, 2026 are urged to act before the August 7, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The lawsuit alleges that offering documents contained false statements regarding BitGo's risk exposure to declining digital asset prices and overstated business prospects. GRAIL investors have an August 4, 2026 deadline for the class action period covering May 13, 2025 to February 19, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is subject to a securities class action lawsuit alleging negligent preparation of IPO offering documents, material misstatements regarding business risks related to digital asset price declines, and lack of reasonable basis for financial performance claims.
Company is subject to an ongoing securities class action lawsuit with investors required to act before the August 4, 2026 deadline, indicating alleged securities violations during the class period.

title: GRAL DEADLINE ALERT: ROSEN, A GLOBAL AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages GRAIL, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important August 4 Deadline in Securities Class Action – GRAL
author: Rosen Law Firm
description: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against GRAIL, Inc. for allegedly providing misleading statements about its NHS-Galleri cancer screening trial. The lawsuit claims defendants concealed material adverse facts about the trial's ability to demonstrate a reduction in Stage III-IV cancers. Investors who purchased GRAIL stock between May 13, 2025 and February 19, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is August 4, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is the subject of a securities class action lawsuit alleging it provided materially false and misleading statements about its NHS-Galleri trial results and concealed adverse facts about the trial's ability to achieve its primary endpoint of reducing Stage III-IV cancers. This represents significant legal and reputational risk to the company.

title: GRAL 集體訴訟的最後期限：全球頂尖法律事務所 ROSEN 鼓勵 GRAIL, Inc. 投資者在對 GRAL 提出證券集體訴訟的重要的截止日期 8 月 4 日之前聘請律師
author: Rosen Law Firm
description: Rosen Law Firm announces a securities class action lawsuit against GRAIL, Inc. (NASDAQ: GRAL) on behalf of investors who purchased shares between May 13, 2025 and February 19, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that GRAIL made false and misleading statements regarding its NHS-Galleri cancer screening trial, concealing that the three-year follow-up period was insufficient to demonstrate stage III-IV cancer reduction and withholding detailed preliminary results that may have shown unfavorable trends.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is the defendant in a securities class action lawsuit alleging material misrepresentations and omissions regarding clinical trial results. Allegations include providing overly positive statements while concealing unfavorable trial data and insufficient evidence of cancer reduction, resulting in investor losses when the truth was revealed.

title: GRAL 10-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: GRAIL, Inc. (NASDAQ: GRAL) Investors Urged to Contact Hagens Berman; Securities Fraud Class Action Filed, August 4, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
author: Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro Llp
description: Hagens Berman has filed a securities fraud class action lawsuit against GRAIL, Inc. (NASDAQ: GRAL) alleging the company misled investors about its NHS-Galleri cancer screening trial's design and efficacy. GRAIL failed to meet the trial's primary endpoint on February 19, 2026, and admitted the three-year follow-up period was insufficient. The stock collapsed 50.55% in a single trading session, erasing $2.2 billion in market capitalization. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company faces securities fraud allegations for misrepresenting clinical trial design and efficacy. Failed to meet primary endpoint, admitted timeline was flawed, and stock crashed 50.55% resulting in $2.2 billion market cap loss.

title: $GRAL Fraud Notification: GRAIL, Inc. Sued for Fraud Over Misrepresentations about its Trial Results – Investors Notified to Contact BFA Law
author: Bleichmar Fonti & Auld Llp
description: GRAIL, Inc. faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit after its stock plummeted 50% on February 20, 2026, following the announcement that its NHS-Galleri cancer trial failed to meet its primary endpoint of reducing late-stage cancers. Investors allege the company misrepresented the trial's design and results, claiming the three-year timeframe was insufficient to achieve the stated objective. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company is the subject of a securities fraud lawsuit due to alleged misrepresentations about trial results. Stock dropped 50.55% after failing to meet primary trial endpoint, indicating significant loss of investor confidence and potential legal liability.
